evidence: empty_void: At seg3:end (f14) three bins sit at the top and the rest of the frame is empty dark gradient apart from a faint "each = 5%". At seg1:start (f07) the line covers only the lower-left third.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg4:start/mid (f15–f18) a fixed grid of 18–20 identical wastebaskets labelled "each = 5%" sits under "Met by new mining 99%". A speech bubble's tail slices through "mining" and Data waves from the corner, and the frame does not change for about 4s.
weakest_scene.root_cause: A stock icon-array machine was given a share it cannot show. At 5% per bin, 1% is a fifth of one bin, so the grid is just '99% = full'. No bin is set apart as the 1% that recycling covers. The closing bubble was laid over the label, and the mascot has no action.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Make the 1% the subject. Put one lit, sorted recycling bin against 99 greyed mining carts (or a pit that keeps deepening), and have Data drop a phone into the lone bin while the pit swallows the rest. Keep the bubble clear of the label and keep something moving through the whole close.
